item.title: Maintenance & Installation Services
item.description:
Professional Installation & Maintenance Across Qatar

We don’t just sell security and technology products — we install, configure, and maintain them. Our certified technicians have years of experience serving homes, mosques, schools, offices, and commercial facilities throughout Doha and Qatar.

CCTV & Security Cameras

  • Indoor and outdoor camera installation
  • NVR and DVR setup and configuration
  • Remote viewing setup (phone, tablet, PC)
  • Camera maintenance and cleaning
  • System upgrades and expansions
  • Fault diagnosis and repair

PA Systems & Audio

  • Mosque PA system design and installation
  • School and office audio setup
  • Ceiling and wall speaker installation
  • Amplifier configuration and tuning
  • Multi-zone audio system setup
  • Emergency PA integration

Network Cabling

  • Cat6, Cat6a, and fiber optic cabling
  • Structural cabling for offices
  • Patch panel and rack installation
  • Network testing and certification
  • WiFi access point installation
  • Cable management and labelling

Smart Home & Access Control

  • Smart door lock installation
  • Video doorphone setup
  • Smart switch and automation configuration
  • Biometric attendance systems
  • Gate and barrier automation
  • Tuya and IoT device integration

Why Choose Us?

Certified Technicians

Trained and experienced in the latest security and network technologies.

Fast Response

Same-day service available in Doha. Quick turnaround across Qatar.

Warranty Backed

All installations come with a service warranty for your peace of mind.
